description: Defines the class 'phy_metrics_pseudo_random_generator_decorator', a decorator for pseudo-random generator metrics, including methods for initialization, state management, XOR application, and generation, with metrics reporting and resource usage measurement.

classes.name: phy_metrics_pseudo_random_generator_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds metrics reporting to a pseudo-random generator, measuring resource usage and notifying metrics.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the generator with a seed, measures CPU usage, and reports metrics.

methods.name: init (overloaded)
methods.description: Initializes the generator with a given state.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the current state of the generator.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances the generator by a specified count, measures CPU usage, and reports metrics.

methods.name: apply_xor (bit_buffer, in)
methods.description: Applies XOR operation on buffers, measures CPU usage, and reports metrics.

methods.name: apply_xor (span<uint8_t>, span<const uint8_t>)
methods.description: Applies XOR on byte spans, measures CPU usage, and reports metrics.

methods.name: apply_xor (span<log_likelihood_ratio>, span<const log_likelihood_ratio>)
methods.description: Applies XOR on soft bit spans, measures CPU usage, and reports metrics.

methods.name: generate (bit_buffer&)
methods.description: Generates random bits, measures CPU usage, and reports metrics.

methods.name: generate (span<float>, float)
methods.description: Generates float values, measures CPU usage, and reports metrics.
